sn35.75:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.75:1.2: amukasmiṃ bhante vihāre aññataro bhikkhu navo appaññāto ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn35.75:1.3: sādhu bhante, bhagavā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
sn35.75:2.1: atha kho bhagavā navavādañca sutvā gilānavādañca appaññāto bhikkhūti iti viditvā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami.
sn35.75:2.2: addasā kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
sn35.75:2.4: atha kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
sn35.75:2.7: nisīdi bhagavā paññatte āsane. nisajja kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca,
sn35.75:2.8: kacci te bhikkhu khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā, paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti?
sn35.75:3.1: na me bhante, khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti. kacci te bhikkhu na kiñci kukkuccaṃ, na koci vippaṭisāroti. taggha me bhante, anappakaṃ kukkuccaṃ, anappako vippaṭisāroti. kacci pana tvaṃ bhikkhu attā sīlato na upavadatīti.
sn35.75:3.2: na kho me bhante attā sīlato upavadatīti.
sn35.75:4.1: no ce kira tvaṃ bhikkhu attā sīlato upavadati, atha kismiñca te kukkuccaṃ, ko ca vippaṭisāroti.
sn35.75:5.1: na khohaṃ bhante sīlavisuddhatthaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn35.75:6.1: no ce kira tvaṃ bhikkhu sīlavisuddhatthaṃ mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi, atha kimatthaṃ carahi tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsīti.
sn35.75:7.1: anupādā parinibbānatthaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn35.75:8.2: sādhu kho pana tvaṃ bhikkhu anupādāparinibbānatthāya mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi.
sn35.75:8.3: anupādā parinibbānattho hi bhikkhu mayā dhammo desito.
sn35.75:9.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi bhikkhu cakkhuṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti. aniccaṃ bhante. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti. dukkhaṃ bhante. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannutaṃ samanupassituṃ “etaṃ mama, eso hamasmi eso me attā”ti. nohetaṃ bhante rūpā niccā vā aniccā vāti. aniccā bhante …pe…
sn35.75:11.9: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti.
sn35.75:13.1: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn35.75:15.1: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ.
sn35.75:17.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, rūpesupi nibbindati, cakkhuviññāṇepi nibbindati, cakkhusamphassepi nibbindati, yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati …pe…
sn35.75:17.5: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati.
sn35.75:17.6: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.75:17.7: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
sn35.75:18.2: attamano so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi.
sn35.75:18.3: imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne tassa bhikkhussa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccīti.
